answer: A joining fee of 1 quartz per identity is burned upon entry, refunded linearly over 100 days through beacon-verified transactions. An attacker running 100 fake identities pays 100 quartz upfront, refunded if each identity maintains honest behavior; a single honest agent pays 1 quartz, refunded daily in 1/100th increments. Oasis nodes track beacon signals to ensure refunds are issued only for verified, continuous participation.
